exposure: Deep learning (DL) imaging based on MRI
cohort: The study included 263 pregnant patients with suspected placenta accreta from two institutions.
finding: The deep learning model based on MRI demonstrated superior performance in the diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum compared to traditional clinical models or machine learning radiomics models.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was identified as an independent clinical risk factor for predicting Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
